space.$description: Gaps, paddings and insets on a 4 px grid with an 8 px base: a name is a step where 100 is the base unit. The named roles are direction B's rhythm and alias the ladder. A density never changes the ladder; it changes the sizes and insets of components and may point a role at another step (decisions/0013).

25.$description: Step 25 of the space ladder: 2 px.

50.$description: Step 50 of the space ladder: 4 px.

75.$description: Step 75 of the space ladder: 6 px.

100.$description: Step 100 of the space ladder: 8 px.

125.$description: Step 125 of the space ladder: 10 px.

150.$description: Step 150 of the space ladder: 12 px.

200.$description: Step 200 of the space ladder: 16 px.

250.$description: Step 250 of the space ladder: 20 px.

300.$description: Step 300 of the space ladder: 24 px.

400.$description: Step 400 of the space ladder: 32 px.

500.$description: Step 500 of the space ladder: 40 px.

600.$description: Step 600 of the space ladder: 48 px.

800.$description: Step 800 of the space ladder: 64 px.

card.$description: A card's padding: the inset between a card's or a panel's edge and its content. 16 px in the comfortable density.

use: inset of a grouped block the product draws
dev.westron.usage.avoid: A system List, Form or bar, which keeps its own insets. A gap between elements: use space.within-group or space.between-groups.

within-group.$description: The gap between the elements of one group: the fields of a form section, the cards of a column, the lines of a block. 12 px in the comfortable density, half the gap between groups, so the grouping shows through space.

use: gap between cards in a column
gap between a heading and its content
dev.westron.usage.avoid: The gap between two groups: use space.between-groups. A component's own internal gap, which its contract gives.

between-groups.$description: The gap between two groups or sections of a screen. 24 px, twice the gap within a group; a density keeps it.

use: gap between groups of a form
gap between blocks of a page
dev.westron.usage.avoid: The gap inside a group: use space.within-group. A separator line where the space already shows the grouping.

narrow.$description: The page margin on a narrow window: on Apple, the horizontal size class compact. 20 px; a density keeps it. It applies to layout the product builds itself, such as a ScrollView or a stack; the system's List, Form and bars keep their own insets.

use: horizontal margin of a scrolling page on a phone
margin of a stack laid out by the product
dev.westron.usage.avoid: A system List, Form or bar, which keeps its own insets. A wide window: use space.page.wide.

wide.$description: The page margin on a wide window: on Apple, the horizontal size class regular, and always on a Mac. 32 px; a density keeps it. It applies to layout the product builds itself, such as a ScrollView or a stack; the system's List, Form and bars keep their own insets.

use: horizontal margin of a page on an iPad or a Mac
margin of a stack laid out by the product
dev.westron.usage.avoid: A system List, Form or bar, which keeps its own insets. A narrow window: use space.page.narrow.
